            <div class="postBody">

<h1 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">Java 集合操作完整清单（Java 8+ Stream API）</span></h1>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">给你一个完整的Java集合操作清单，包含代码示例。现代Java推荐使用Stream API进行集合操作。</span></p>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">1. 过滤操作</span></h2>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded highlighter-hljs" lang="java" spellcheck="false"><code>// 过滤符合条件的元素
List&lt;Integer&gt; numbers = Arrays.asList(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6);
List&lt;Integer&gt; even = numbers.stream()
 &nbsp;  .filter(n -&gt; n % 2 == 0)
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.toList()); // [2, 4, 6]
​
// 去重
List&lt;Integer&gt; withDups = Arrays.asList(1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3);
List&lt;Integer&gt; distinct = withDups.stream()
 &nbsp;  .distinct()
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.toList()); // [1, 2, 3]
​
// 分页（跳过前n个，取前m个）
List&lt;Integer&gt; paged = numbers.stream()
 &nbsp;  .skip(2)
 &nbsp;  .limit(3)
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.toList()); // [3, 4, 5]</code></pre>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">2. 映射操作</span></h2>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded highlighter-hljs" lang="java" spellcheck="false"><code>// 类型转换
List&lt;String&gt; strings = Arrays.asList("1", "2", "3");
List&lt;Integer&gt; ints = strings.stream()
 &nbsp;  .map(Integer::parseInt)
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.toList()); // [1, 2, 3]
​
// 提取对象属性
List&lt;User&gt; users = getUsers();
List&lt;String&gt; names = users.stream()
 &nbsp;  .map(User::getName)
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.toList());
​
// 扁平化（将多个集合合并为一个）
List&lt;List&lt;Integer&gt;&gt; nested = Arrays.asList(
 &nbsp; &nbsp;Arrays.asList(1, 2),
 &nbsp; &nbsp;Arrays.asList(3, 4)
);
List&lt;Integer&gt; flat = nested.stream()
 &nbsp;  .flatMap(List::stream)
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.toList()); // [1, 2, 3, 4]</code></pre>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">3. 排序操作</span></h2>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded highlighter-hljs" lang="java" spellcheck="false"><code>List&lt;Integer&gt; nums = Arrays.asList(3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 9);
​
// 自然排序（升序）
List&lt;Integer&gt; sorted = nums.stream()
 &nbsp;  .sorted()
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.toList()); // [1, 1, 3, 4, 5, 9]
​
// 自定义排序（降序）
List&lt;Integer&gt; reversed = nums.stream()
 &nbsp;  .sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder())
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.toList()); // [9, 5, 4, 3, 1, 1]
​
// 按对象属性排序
List&lt;User&gt; users = getUsers();
List&lt;User&gt; sortedByAge = users.stream()
 &nbsp;  .sorted(Comparator.comparing(User::getAge))
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.toList());
​
// 多字段排序
List&lt;User&gt; sortedMulti = users.stream()
 &nbsp;  .sorted(Comparator.comparing(User::getAge)
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  .thenComparing(User::getName))
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.toList());</code></pre>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">4. 聚合操作（取最大、最小、求和等）</span></h2>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded highlighter-hljs" lang="java" spellcheck="false"><code>List&lt;Integer&gt; nums = Arrays.asList(3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 9);
​
// 求和
int sum = nums.stream()
 &nbsp;  .mapToInt(Integer::intValue)
 &nbsp;  .sum(); // 23
​
// 取最大值
Optional&lt;Integer&gt; max = nums.stream()
 &nbsp;  .max(Integer::compareTo); // Optional[9]
​
// 取最小值
Optional&lt;Integer&gt; min = nums.stream()
 &nbsp;  .min(Integer::compareTo); // Optional[1]
​
// 平均值
double avg = nums.stream()
 &nbsp;  .mapToDouble(Integer::doubleValue)
 &nbsp;  .average()
 &nbsp;  .orElse(0.0); // 3.83
​
// 统计汇总
IntSummaryStatistics stats = nums.stream()
 &nbsp;  .mapToInt(Integer::intValue)
 &nbsp;  .summaryStatistics();
// stats.getCount(), stats.getSum(), stats.getMin(), stats.getMax(), stats.getAverage()
​
// 自定义reduce
Optional&lt;Integer&gt; product = nums.stream()
 &nbsp;  .reduce((a, b) -&gt; a * b); // 所有数相乘</code></pre>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">5. 集合操作（交集、并集、差集）</span></h2>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded highlighter-hljs" lang="java" spellcheck="false"><code>Set&lt;Integer&gt; set1 = new HashSet&lt;&gt;(Arrays.asList(1, 2, 3, 4));
Set&lt;Integer&gt; set2 = new HashSet&lt;&gt;(Arrays.asList(3, 4, 5, 6));
​
// 交集
Set&lt;Integer&gt; intersection = set1.stream()
 &nbsp;  .filter(set2::contains)
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.toSet()); // [3, 4]
​
// 并集
Set&lt;Integer&gt; union = new HashSet&lt;&gt;(set1);
union.addAll(set2); // [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
​
// 差集（set1有但set2没有）
Set&lt;Integer&gt; difference = set1.stream()
 &nbsp;  .filter(n -&gt; !set2.contains(n))
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.toSet()); // [1, 2]
​
// 对称差集（只在其中一个集合的元素）
Set&lt;Integer&gt; disjunctive = set1.stream()
 &nbsp;  .filter(n -&gt; !set2.contains(n))
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.toSet());
set2.stream()
 &nbsp;  .filter(n -&gt; !set1.contains(n))
 &nbsp;  .forEach(disjunctive::add); // [1, 2, 5, 6]</code></pre>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">6. 分组操作</span></h2>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded highlighter-hljs" lang="java" spellcheck="false"><code>List&lt;User&gt; users = getUsers();
​
// 按单个字段分组
Map&lt;String, List&lt;User&gt;&gt; groupedByCity = users.stream()
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(User::getCity));
​
// 按条件分组
Map&lt;String, List&lt;User&gt;&gt; groupedByAgeRange = users.stream()
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(u -&gt; 
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;u.getAge() &gt; 30 ? "中年" : "青年"
 &nbsp;  ));
​
// 多级分组
Map&lt;String, Map&lt;String, List&lt;User&gt;&gt;&gt; multiGroup = users.stream()
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(User::getCity,
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Collectors.groupingBy(User::getGender)));
​
// 分组并统计数量
Map&lt;String, Long&gt; countByCity = users.stream()
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(User::getCity,
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Collectors.counting()));
​
// 分组并求和
Map&lt;String, Integer&gt; sumAgeByCity = users.stream()
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(User::getCity,
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Collectors.summingInt(User::getAge)));
​
// 分组并取最大
Map&lt;String, Optional&lt;User&gt;&gt; maxAgeByCity = users.stream()
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(User::getCity,
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Collectors.maxBy(Comparator.comparing(User::getAge))));</code></pre>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">7. 分区操作</span></h2>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded highlighter-hljs" lang="java" spellcheck="false"><code>// 按布尔条件分区（只能分为两组）
List&lt;Integer&gt; nums = Arrays.asList(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6);
​
Map&lt;Boolean, List&lt;Integer&gt;&gt; partitioned = nums.stream()
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.partitioningBy(n -&gt; n % 2 == 0));
// {false=[1, 3, 5], true=[2, 4, 6]}</code></pre>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">8. 匹配操作</span></h2>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded highlighter-hljs" lang="java" spellcheck="false"><code>List&lt;Integer&gt; nums = Arrays.asList(1, 2, 3, 4, 5);
​
// 是否全部匹配
boolean allEven = nums.stream()
 &nbsp;  .allMatch(n -&gt; n % 2 == 0); // false
​
// 是否有任意匹配
boolean anyEven = nums.stream()
 &nbsp;  .anyMatch(n -&gt; n % 2 == 0); // true
​
// 是否全部不匹配
boolean noneMatch = nums.stream()
 &nbsp;  .noneMatch(n -&gt; n &gt; 10); // true</code></pre>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">9. 查找操作</span></h2>
<pre class="md-fences mock-cm md-end-block highlighter-hljs" lang="java" spellcheck="false"><code>List&lt;Integer&gt; nums = Arrays.asList(1, 2, 3, 4, 5);

// 查找第一个
Optional&lt;Integer&gt; first = nums.stream()
    .findFirst(); // Optional[1]

// 查找任意一个（并行流时更高效）
Optional&lt;Integer&gt; any = nums.stream()
    .findAny(); // Optional[1]

// 配合过滤查找第一个匹配
Optional&lt;Integer&gt; firstEven = nums.stream()
    .filter(n -&gt; n % 2 == 0)
    .findFirst(); // Optional[2]</code></pre>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">10. 其他实用操作</span></h2>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded highlighter-hljs" lang="java" spellcheck="false"><code>List&lt;String&gt; strings = Arrays.asList("a", "b", "c", "d");
​
// 字符串拼接
String joined = strings.stream()
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.joining(", ")); // "a, b, c, d"
​
// 转Map
Map&lt;Integer, String&gt; idToNameMap = users.stream()
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.toMap(User::getId, User::getName));
​
// 处理Map的Entry
Map&lt;String, Integer&gt; map = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
map.entrySet().stream()
 &nbsp;  .filter(entry -&gt; entry.getValue() &gt; 10)
 &nbsp;  .forEach(System.out::println);
​
// 去重并保持顺序
List&lt;Integer&gt; withDups = Arrays.asList(1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3);
List&lt;Integer&gt; distinctOrdered = withDups.stream()
 &nbsp;  .distinct()
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.toList()); // [1, 2, 3]
​
// 自定义收集器（如果需要）
Collector&lt;Integer, ?, List&lt;Integer&gt;&gt; customCollector = 
 &nbsp; &nbsp;Collectors.toCollection(LinkedList::new);</code></pre>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">性能提示</span></h2>
<ol class="ol-list" start="">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">大数据量</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：考虑使用并行流 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>.parallelStream()</code></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">原始类型</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：使用 </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>IntStream</code></span><span class="md-plain">, </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>LongStream</code></span><span class="md-plain">, </span><span class="md-pair-s" spellcheck="false"><code>DoubleStream</code></span><span class="md-plain"> 避免装箱开销</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">提前过滤</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：先过滤减少后续操作的数据量</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">避免多次遍历</span></strong></span><span class="md-plain">：尽量在一次流操作中完成所有处理</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">传统方式 vs Stream API</span></h2>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded highlighter-hljs" lang="java" spellcheck="false"><code>// 传统for循环
List&lt;Integer&gt; result = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();
for (Integer n : numbers) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp;if (n &gt; 3) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;result.add(n * 2);
 &nbsp;  }
}
​
// Stream方式（更简洁）
List&lt;Integer&gt; result = numbers.stream()
 &nbsp;  .filter(n -&gt; n &gt; 3)
 &nbsp;  .map(n -&gt; n * 2)
 &nbsp;  .collect(Collectors.toList());</code></pre>
